subject.title: fix(plugins): honor subagent model-override opt-in in interactive sessions

question: Should `plugins.entries.<id>.subagent.allowModelOverride` authorize interactive plugin subagent overrides while inherited internal override flags no longer count as plugin caller authority for nested spawns?
rationale: This changes a shipped trust boundary for model/provider selection in both a widening direction and a fail-closed hardening direction, so maintainer intent matters even though the patch is technically coherent.

options.title: Approve widened opt-in plus hardening
options.body: Treat the config key as plugin-wide trust for interactive and background subagent runs, while requiring nested spawns to pass the same per-plugin policy.

options.title: Keep background-only semantics
options.body: Reject the interactive widening and update docs/errors to make the older background-only behavior explicit.

options.title: Split the hardening
options.body: Land the inherited-flag hardening separately from the interactive widening if maintainers want lower upgrade risk per PR.

recommendation.title: Approve widened opt-in plus hardening
recommendation.body: Treat the config key as plugin-wide trust for interactive and background subagent runs, while requiring nested spawns to pass the same per-plugin policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the original per-plugin subagent override policy and are the best history-backed owner for the trust-boundary decision.
